what: Telemetry / analytics default is ON (opt-out model) — user explicitly corrected this on 2026-04-22. `src/memory/config.ts` DEFAULT_CONFIG.telemetry.enabled = true. `src/memory/store.ts:83` telemetryEnabled defaults to true. The constructor at src/memory/store.ts:139-152 only flips it to false when user explicitly sets `telemetry.enabled: false` in .aide/config.json. IMPORTANT: I previously stored memory #266 claiming the default was opt-in (false) — that was WRONG and has been deleted. The code has always been opt-out; no change to behavior happened. The "telemetry" name is misleading — it only gates the LOCAL Analytics table writer in store.ts; aide-memory has NO phone-home channel. Despite the name, no data leaves the user's machine. Confirm in any future reference: defaults=TRUE, semantics=opt-out, impact=local-only. User preference per memory #202 (still valid): users share analytics by default for product-visibility signals.
why: Supersedes deleted memory #266 which was factually wrong. This is the authoritative description of telemetry default. Captured after user caught my error — I had treated #266 as newer=authoritative when it actually contradicted both the code and the prior user preference #202.
